billing_discount.label: Discount
billing_discount.explain: More than the counter may give without your approval.

billing_clearance_discount.label: Discount to settle dues
billing_clearance_discount.ask: Discount of {{amount}} to settle {{patient}}'s unpaid dues
billing_clearance_discount.explain: Part of an unpaid bill is written off so the patient can clear the rest.

billing_credit_extension.label: Pay later (credit)
billing_credit_extension.ask: Let {{patient}} pay the rest of the bill later
billing_credit_extension.explain: The bill is issued now and the balance is collected later — more credit than the counter may give.

billing_refund.label: Refund
billing_refund.explain: Money goes back to the patient.

billing_variance.label: Cash count mismatch
billing_variance.ask: Accept a cashier's closing cash count that does not match
billing_variance.explain: At closing, the cash in a drawer did not match what the system expected. Approving accepts the count.

lab_release_unpaid.label: Unpaid lab report
lab_release_unpaid.ask: Give {{patient}}'s lab report with {{amount}} still unpaid
lab_release_unpaid.explain: The report is held until the bill is paid. Approving lets the lab hand it over now.

patient_merge.label: Merge duplicate records
patient_merge.explain: The same person was registered twice. Approving merges the two records.

patient_unmerge.label: Undo a merge
patient_unmerge.explain: Two records were joined by mistake. Approving splits them back apart.

materials_stock_adjustment.label: Stock correction, destruction or item merge
materials_stock_adjustment.ask: Correct the store's stock after a physical count, destroy expired stock that cannot go back, or merge a duplicate item into the one that stays
materials_stock_adjustment.explain: A count found more or less stock than the system shows, stock is to be destroyed under the BMW Rules, or one item is registered twice (the request names which). Approving corrects the stock, lets it be handed over for destruction, or lets the duplicate's stock and open work move to the item that stays — its history stays as written.

materials_near_expiry_acceptance.label: Stock that expires soon
materials_near_expiry_acceptance.ask: Accept a delivery of items that expire soon
materials_near_expiry_acceptance.explain: The supplier sent items with a short shelf life. Approving lets the store accept them.

materials_vendor_bank_change.label: Supplier bank change
materials_vendor_bank_change.ask: Change the bank account a supplier is paid into
materials_vendor_bank_change.explain: Future payments go to the new account. Confirm it with the supplier by phone before approving.

imaging_definition_publish.label: Radiology settings
imaging_definition_publish.ask: Put new radiology settings into use
imaging_definition_publish.explain: Scan types, safety checks or critical-result rules change for everyone once approved.

ot_definition_publish.label: OT settings
ot_definition_publish.ask: Put new operation theatre settings into use
ot_definition_publish.explain: OT criteria, surgeon privileges, deposit rules or recovery limits change once approved.

ot_deposit_exception.label: Short deposit
ot_deposit_exception.ask: Go ahead with {{patient}}'s day-care surgery with the deposit {{amount}} short
ot_deposit_exception.explain: The patient has paid less than the deposit required before surgery.

tariff_revision.label: Price list change
tariff_revision.ask: Put a new price list (tariff) into use
tariff_revision.explain: New prices for hospital services take effect once approved.

membership_grace_honor.label: Membership card
membership_grace_honor.ask: Give {{patient}} member benefits on a card missing from the member list
membership_grace_honor.explain: The card is not in the member list. Approving gives the benefit this time.

materials_po_approval.label: Purchase order
materials_po_approval.explain: The pharmacy or the stores want to order from a supplier. Approving lets them send the order; you cannot then receive its delivery.

materials_po_approval_owner.label: Purchase order above the limit
materials_po_approval_owner.ask: Approve a purchase order of {{amount}}, above the materials head's limit
materials_po_approval_owner.explain: Orders above the limit come to you. Approving lets them send the order to the supplier.

materials_payment_run_approval.label: Supplier payment run
materials_payment_run_approval.explain: The materials head or the pharmacist in charge prepared a run of supplier bills to pay. Authorising lets somebody else pay them and record it; you cannot record it yourself.

billing_credit_owner.label: Credit (only you approve)
billing_credit_owner.explain: The bill is issued now and this amount is owed. Your ruling: nobody but the owner gives credit.

lab_release_unpaid_owner.label: Hand over an unpaid lab report
lab_release_unpaid_owner.explain: The report leaves before the money — that is credit, and only you approve it. The amount stays owed.

billing_refund_owner.label: Refund above ₹25,000 (only you approve)
billing_refund_owner.explain: Money goes back to the patient. Your ruling: a refund above ₹25,000.00 is yours to approve, not the billing manager's.

billing_recon_charge_owner.label: Bank short-payment write-off (only you approve)
billing_recon_charge_owner.ask: Write off {{amount}} the bank did not pay on {{patient}}'s receipt
billing_recon_charge_owner.explain: The shortfall is recorded as the bank's charge and the receipt reconciles. Your ruling: the billing manager writes off up to ₹50.00 per receipt; above that it is yours.

pharmacy_discount_incharge.label: Pharmacy discount above 10%
pharmacy_discount_incharge.explain: The pharmacist may give up to 10% off MRP; above that, up to 25%, is yours as pharmacy in-charge. The percentage and the reason are in the note. You may not approve a discount you asked for.

pharmacy_discount_owner.label: Pharmacy discount above 25% or ₹25,000 (only you approve)
pharmacy_discount_owner.explain: Your ruling: a discount above 25% of MRP, or worth more than ₹25,000 on one bill, is yours to approve. The percentage and the reason are in the note.

pharmacy_restricted_antimicrobial.label: Restricted antimicrobial
pharmacy_restricted_antimicrobial.explain: The pharmacy may hand this Reserve or restricted antibiotic over for this prescription. You may not approve a prescription you wrote yourself.

imaging_release_unpaid_owner.label: Hand over an unpaid imaging report
imaging_release_unpaid_owner.ask: Release {{patient}}'s imaging report with {{amount}} still unpaid
imaging_release_unpaid_owner.explain: The patient's copy leaves before the money — that is credit, and only you approve it. The amount stays owed; the doctor already has the report.

mapping.title: Release substances: what each one is
mapping.intro: The national release names substances, often as a salt (warfarin sodium). The safety checks need the moiety (warfarin). The system drafts; you decide, one substance at a time. A draft is advice: nothing is mapped until you press a button, and there is no way to accept many at once.

clearance.notConfigured: {{category}} has no cap configured, so no clearance discount can be issued against it — an administrator must add a cap rule for this category in the tariff module.

advanceLane.noReceipts: No receipt on this patient to draw from

terminal.title: This cannot be undone from here

billingSession.title: Cashier session
billingSession.noSession: No drawer is open. Open one before taking money at the counter.
billingSession.confirmCloseHint: After it is approved, press Finish closing. Until then the drawer will not close.
billingSession.notApprovedYet: Not approved yet. A billing manager has to approve this variance before the drawer can close.
billingSession.approvalPending: Someone other than you has to decide it.
billingSession.approvalPendingSince: Waiting since {{time}}. Someone other than you has to decide it.
billingSession.approvalGranted: A billing manager approved this variance. Finish closing to close the drawer.
billingSession.approvalRejected: A billing manager did not approve this variance. Withdraw the count and count the drawer again.

open.title: Open a drawer
open.explain: Count the float into the drawer, type it here, then open. It is the figure the close is counted against.

close.title: Count the drawer
close.warning: Any difference between the counted cash and the expected cash moves this drawer to awaiting-approval and stops you taking money until a billing manager decides it.

recount.open: Wrong amount? Withdraw this count and count again
recount.explain: This does not erase anything. The count above is written to the record with your reason, and a supervisor still confirms the corrected close — you just do not have to wait for one to fix a typo.
recount.reason: Why is this count being withdrawn?
recount.reasonRequired: Say why the count is being withdrawn — the record is worthless without it.

openItems.title: Open on this drawer
openItems.mismatchedBody: The bank's statement did not match what was taken. The billing office settles it — tell them before you close.
openItems.unconfirmedBody: Taken and receipted; the settlement statement has not confirmed it yet. Nothing to do at the counter — it is not in your cash.
openItems.refundsBody: Approved and not yet paid. The patient may come back today — hold the cash, do not bank it.
openItems.partPaidBody: You took money against these and a balance is still due.
openItems.clear: Nothing is open on this drawer.

ifClosed.title: If you closed the drawer now
ifClosed.blindTitle: Count it before you see the figure
ifClosed.blindBody: The count opens blank and the drawer's total stays hidden until you have typed yours. A cashier shown the answer first will find it every time — and a real short will never be found.

request.title: Request a refund
request.required: A subject, an amount and a reason are all required before a refund can be requested
request.filed: Approval {{approvalId}} is filed — a billing manager other than you must grant it before a voucher can be issued.

eie.title: Void a receipt (entered in error)
eie.required: A receipt and a reason are both required
eie.cascade: Every allocation this receipt made will be reversed and the bills it settled go back to outstanding. Receipt {{receiptId}} cannot be un-voided.
eie.done_one: The receipt is voided and {{count}} allocation was reversed.
eie.done_other: The receipt is voided and {{count}} allocations were reversed.
eie.receiptFilter: Type the printed receipt number to narrow the list
eie.noReceipts: This patient has no receipt to void

page.unbilled: Visits with no bill — any date

today.empty: Nothing needs the billing office right now.
today.noTabs: No filter tabs. The list is the whole office; pages for browsing everything live in the header menu.
today.idle: Open a row from “Needs you today” — its steps come here, with the one act pinned at the bottom.

nothing.body: Pick a row from the list. Its facts come here; its steps and its act open in the middle.

daybook_paper.sub: {{amount}} taken on paper · check against the slips

pay.head: Pay a refund — {{patient}}
pay.why: {{reason}}. The voucher is approved and issued; nobody has handed the money over yet.
pay.footer: Paid by whoever holds billing.refund.pay — cash from their own open drawer. Esc puts it back.
pay.approvedM: {{at}} by {{by}} · every refund is approved before a voucher exists
pay.approvedOwnerM: {{at}} by {{by}} · above ₹25,000.00 only the owner approves a refund
pay.issuedM: {{voucherNo}} · {{amount}} · {{method}} · capped at what the hospital actually received
pay.whoM: The name as on the ID shown at the counter. Look at the ID; its number is not written down — Aadhaar is never stored (owner ruling 28-Sep-2026).
pay.drawerOpen: Your drawer · open since {{time}}. The payout is written to this drawer’s close; its expected cash stays hidden until you count (blind count, owner ruling 28-Sep-2026).
pay.drawerNone: You have no drawer open. Open your cashier session before paying cash.
pay.drawerBank: No drawer: this refund leaves by bank transfer.
pay.signM: The payee signs for the money in the refund register. A printed voucher is not available on this screen yet.
pay.whyCash: The drawer shortens by {{amount}} the moment you pay.
pay.whyBank: Record it only after the transfer has left the bank.
pay.required: Type the payee’s name and choose the ID shown.

recon.whyHere: The bank’s statement did not settle what it owed after its fee. Until someone decides, the difference is money nobody has accounted for.
recon.whyDisputed: Raised with the bank. It stays on the clocks until the credit arrives on a later statement — or you decide otherwise.
recon.owed: What the bank owed and paid
recon.owedM: Expected is fixed when the money was taken, from the fee rate on that day — a later fee change never rewrites it.
recon.disputeT: Raise a dispute with the bank; the row stays open until the credit arrives on a later statement.
recon.chargeB: Accept it as a bank charge.
recon.chargeT: Written off with your reason. Up to {{limit}} per receipt you decide; above it the owner does (owner ruling 28-Sep-2026).
recon.notShort: Only a short settlement can be a bank charge — the bank paid more than expected.
recon.reuploadT: The row goes back to waiting; upload the corrected statement and it matches again.
recon.actDispute: Raise a dispute with the bank
recon.actReupload: Send back for the corrected statement
recon.whyDispute: A dispute keeps the {{amount}} on the clock list until it is credited.
recon.whyCharge: The receipt reconciles and the difference is recorded as the bank’s charge, with your reason.
recon.whyOwner: {{amount}} is above {{limit}}: the owner decides. Nothing changes until the owner says yes.
recon.whyApply: The owner said yes to this write-off; applying it reconciles the receipt.
recon.whyReupload: The settled figure is cleared; the corrected statement settles it afresh.
recon.pendingOwner: The owner has been asked to accept {{amount}}. It waits on the clocks until the owner decides.

done.bank_charge: {{amount}} on {{receiptNo}} is recorded as a bank charge.

issue_voucher.stepM: The refund is approved. Choose how it will be paid back, then issue the voucher. It goes to the cashier's list to pay.
issue_voucher.bankOnly: Above {{limit}} a refund is paid by bank transfer only.
issue_voucher.nextM: Then it shows as “Pay this voucher”: the cashier records who takes the money and pays it from the drawer (cash) or by bank transfer.
issue_voucher.done: Voucher {{voucherNo}} issued — it is now on the list to pay.

approve_refund.stepM: Every refund is approved before a voucher exists. Above {{limit}} the owner decides instead.

refund_owner.stepM: Above {{limit}} only the owner approves a refund (owner ruling 28-Sep-2026).

unbilled_visit.why: This visit owed a consultation fee and no bill was raised against it.
unbilled_visit.step2M: The billing counter opens on this visit, with its fee.

recon_missing.why: UPI and card money from a finished day is still waiting for the bank’s statement.
recon_missing.stepM: Each row is matched by its reference; what does not match is reported, never guessed.

daybook_paper.why: Receipts were written on paper while the system was down.
daybook_paper.stepM: The day book shows the paper receipts in its degraded figure.

gstr1_due.why: Outward supplies are filed on GSTR-1 by the 11th of the next month.
gstr1_due.stepM: By buyer GSTIN, SAC and rate — the stored head sums, never re-derived.

waiting.empty: No refund is waiting for a decision.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.why: If an administrator issued this password, you must choose your own before you can use the system.
changePassword.rule: At least 10 characters. No upper-case or symbol rules — length is what matters. It must not be your username.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match

adminUsers.title: Users and access
adminUsers.createWhy: The new account must change this password at first sign-in. A PIN is optional and enables the fast terminal switch.
adminUsers.rule: Password: at least 10 characters, not the username. PIN: 4 to 6 digits.
adminUsers.twoAdminWarning: Fewer than two people on this deployment hold the full auth.* set — {{n}} today. A password reset may only be performed by somebody who holds everything the target holds, so below TWO such people a forgotten password at the top has no repair but direct database access. Add a second person and give them the admin role.
adminUsers.noRoles: none — this person can reach nothing
adminUsers.allRolesHeld: Holds every role on this deployment
adminUsers.roleAssigned: {{roleKey}} was assigned to {{username}} — it takes effect on their next action
adminUsers.grantsAccessAuthority: This role carries authority over access itself: who exists, who may do what, and whose password can be reset. Give it only to someone you would trust with the hospital's accounts.
adminUsers.inertScope: — grants nothing today; every route requires hospital scope. Revoke and re-assign at hospital scope.
adminUsers.resetPasswordWhy: Every session this person holds will be signed out, and they must choose their own password at the next sign-in.
adminUsers.resetPinWhy: The PIN changes and nothing else. Sessions stay signed in.
adminUsers.passwordReset: {{username}}'s password was reset and their sessions were signed out
adminUsers.reactivated: {{username}} was reactivated — they can sign in again

error.admin_lockout: Refused: this would leave nobody able to administer users. Give somebody else that authority first.
error.user_not_found: That person no longer exists — reload the list
error.role_not_found: That role does not exist on this deployment — reload the list

adminUsers.askPlaceholder: ask about accounts, roles or who can do what…
adminUsers.agentIdle: I read this roster only — the accounts on this deployment, the roles each one holds, and how many full administrators there are. I have no model behind me and I cannot change anything; every button here is yours.

agent.admins_one: {{count}} full administrator. Two is the floor: with one, a single lost password locks the hospital out of its own access control.
agent.admins_other: {{count}} full administrators. Two is the floor: with one, a single lost password locks the hospital out of its own access control.
agent.noRoles: These accounts hold no role at all, so they can sign in and do nothing: {{list}}.
agent.allHaveRoles: Every account holds at least one role.
agent.inert_one: {{count}} role assignment is scoped below hospital. Every route in this system requires a hospital scope, so that row grants its holder nothing — the screen marks it.
agent.inert_other: {{count}} role assignments are scoped below hospital. Every route in this system requires a hospital scope, so those rows grant their holder nothing — the screen marks each one.
agent.noInert: No inert role assignments — every holding is hospital-scoped.
agent.cannot: I cannot answer that from this screen. I can tell you about the accounts listed here, the roles they hold, how many full administrators there are, and which assignments are inert.

counterInstruments.rateLimited: Too many lookups. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

couponReason.not_yet_valid: This coupon has not started yet
couponReason.off_weekday: This coupon does not run today
couponReason.outside_window: This coupon is outside its hours
couponReason.min_bill_not_met: The bill is below this coupon's minimum

counterInstruments.subtitle: कार्ड पहचान · scan, check, carry it to the bill
counterInstruments.laneEmpty: Scan or type a card and it appears here: its number, whether it can be used today, who holds it and what is left on it.
counterInstruments.scanHint: Card number, mobile or holder name. Enter recognises what you typed.

noMatch.title: No card in the holder book matches {{code}}.
noMatch.body: Check the digits, or search by the holder's mobile. If the partner's list has not reached us yet, a supervisor can allow it once (grace honour).
noMatch.grace: Grace honour needs a front office supervisor's approval before anything applies. Until then the visit is billed at the full rate.

dock.noMatch: Bill without the card, or ask a supervisor for grace honour
dock.coupon: Type {{code}} on the bill; the bill checks it
dock.reconcile: Link the holder in Reconcile before this card is used:
dock.fullRate: No card benefit. Bill today's visit at the hospital's full rate
dock.pickVisit: Pick today's visit to carry this card to its bill

counterInstruments.name: Name
counterInstruments.countsOnly: Counts of visits only. No rupee figure is shown at the counter; the saving is worked out once, on the bill.
counterInstruments.step2: Which of today's visits is it for?

unlinked.title: This card is not linked to a patient yet.
unlinked.body: A card nobody is linked to is never applied at the counter. Reconcile links the holder first; until then bill at the full rate.

refuse.suspended: The card's issuer has paused this card.
refuse.body: Nothing on it applies to today's bill. Card sales and renewals are not done at this counter; the member can ask the card's issuer.

counterInstruments.visitsAtBill: The visit is picked on the bill.
counterInstruments.noVisit: No visit today for this patient. Send them to Desk One first, then come back to the card.
counterInstruments.visitsFrom: Visits are read from OPD for this UHID. A patient with no visit today is sent to Desk One first.
counterInstruments.step3: What the bill will do with this card
counterInstruments.twoBenefits: If two benefits reach one line
counterInstruments.largerWins: the larger one wins; they never add up
counterInstruments.onlyOnIssue: The benefit is worked out by the bill, on the bill. Nothing is used up until the bill is issued; cancelling the bill gives the visit back.
counterInstruments.verbatim: The server's own sentence, shown word for word.
counterInstruments.todayEmpty: No card recognised at this counter today.

instrumentReconcile.title: Card reconcile
instrumentReconcile.place: Cards the import could not link by itself
instrumentReconcile.rowCap: {{code}} · {{n}} people on a {{cap}}-person card — call the partner
instrumentReconcile.rowLapsed: {{benefit}} given back after the card ended
instrumentReconcile.pick: Pick a card from the queue.
instrumentReconcile.neverLinks: The import never links a card to a patient by itself, however close the names look. Every link is your decision and is recorded against your name.
instrumentReconcile.lapsedPlace: Benefit given back after the card ended
instrumentReconcile.whyFuzzy_one: The name on the card resembles {{count}} registered patient. The import never links a card by itself: you decide, and the link is permanent and recorded against your name.
instrumentReconcile.whyFuzzy_other: The name on the card resembles {{count}} registered patients. The import never links a card by itself: you decide, and the link is permanent and recorded against your name.
instrumentReconcile.whyCap: The partner sent more people on this card than its plan covers. The first ones in the file are honoured; the rest are recorded and wait for the partner.
instrumentReconcile.mobileProvesNothing: The mobile alone proves nothing: one family often shares one number.
instrumentReconcile.putBack: put it back in the queue
instrumentReconcile.flowHint: Compare, choose one or none, then link
instrumentReconcile.step1: Compare the card with each patient
instrumentReconcile.step2: Choose one patient — or none of them
instrumentReconcile.noCandidates: No patient you may see resembles this holder — nothing to link.
instrumentReconcile.noneHint: If nobody here is the card holder, use “None of these” and say why.

proof.id_seen: Saw an ID at the counter

instrumentReconcile.proofPlaceholder: What you saw or heard, in words — never type an ID number
instrumentReconcile.noIdNumbers: Leave ID numbers out. Say what you saw, not the number: Aadhaar numbers are never stored.
instrumentReconcile.barChoose: Choose a patient above, or “None of these”
instrumentReconcile.barPermanent: Permanent. Recorded against {{user}} at the moment you press it.
instrumentReconcile.weakMobile: Only the mobile agrees, and a family often shares one mobile.
instrumentReconcile.weakWouldPut: Linking puts {{name}}’s card on this record for good.
instrumentReconcile.howKnow: How do you know it is the same person? · required

weakProof.id_seen: Saw an ID at the counter
weakProof.called_mobile: Called the card’s mobile and the holder confirmed

instrumentReconcile.weakConfirm: I understand this link is permanent and carries my name.
instrumentReconcile.reasonSaved: The reason is saved with the link.

dismissReason.not_registered: Not registered here yet — link at the first visit
dismissReason.partner_file_wrong: The partner’s file is wrong — told the partner

instrumentReconcile.dismissNote: A line for the next person
instrumentReconcile.dismissPlaceholder: Add a line for the next person (optional unless “Other”)
instrumentReconcile.staysUnlinked: The card stays unlinked and still works at the counter by its number. When the holder next registers, the counter offers the link there.
instrumentReconcile.capWhy: Nothing here is linked. Call the partner, tell them which members are over the plan’s cap, then close this with what they said.
instrumentReconcile.capBar: Close this once the partner has been told
instrumentReconcile.lapsedTitle: A benefit came back to {{name}}’s ended card
instrumentReconcile.lapsedWhy: A bill was reversed and its {{benefit}} returned to a card that had already ended. Check with the member whether the card was renewed.

instrumentReconcile.lapsedBar: Mark it checked once you have spoken to the member

partnerReceivables.title: Partner receivables
partnerReceivables.noIdentity: This desk works from a partner's statement. It shows referral slips, amounts and dates — never a patient's name, UHID or phone.
partnerReceivables.scanLabel: Scan or type a referral slip code
partnerReceivables.scanMissed: No slip with that code. A slip either scans or it does not — nothing is matched by resemblance.
partnerReceivables.statementWhy: Every line is matched by id. A line quoting a slip we never issued, or another partner's slip, is disputed rather than paid.

dispute.attribution_partner_mismatch: This slip belongs to another partner
dispute.amount_mismatch: The partner's amount differs from ours

partnerPnl.title: Channel P&L
partnerPnl.noIdentity: Every number here is a count or a sum — cards, spend, commission and receivables. Nothing is a patient's name, UHID or phone.

materialsItems.title: Item master
materialsItems.lead: Every item the hospital stocks, those in use first. Register a new one with N; Edit sets its HSN, storage, schedule and the LASA and high-alert flags.
materialsItems.name: Name
materialsItems.baseUomHint: Every quantity this hospital ever records for this item is counted in this unit. It cannot be changed afterwards.
materialsItems.formularyMedicineHint: A drug-class item must name the medicine it stocks; composition and salts stay in the formulary.
materialsItems.packMultiplierHint: How many base units one pack holds — a box of 10 strips of 10 tablets is 100.

edit.title: {{code}} · {{name}}
edit.lasaNote: LASA warning (the names it is confused with)
edit.scheduleReadOnly: The schedule belongs to the formulary medicine; only someone who manages the formulary can change it.
edit.flagsHint: The counter shows these on the dispense line so the pharmacist reads the strip twice. Off means nobody has said so — not that it is safe.
edit.gstReadOnly: GST is changed by the pharmacist in charge (What the counter sells), so the bill's rate moves with it.
edit.packInvalid: Give the new pack a name and a size of 2 or more.

materialsVendors.dateBad: Type the date as DD-MM-YYYY, for example 31-03-2027.
materialsVendors.dateHint: Valid to: DD-MM-YYYY, for a licence. Leave empty for a PAN or GST certificate.
materialsVendors.missingDocs: Cannot activate yet — add these documents below under Documents first: {{docs}}. Each needs its number; a licence also its valid-to date.
materialsVendors.title: Vendor master
materialsVendors.draftHint: A new vendor is a draft. It cannot be received from until its GST certificate and PAN are on file and it is activated.
materialsVendors.blacklistHint: Three years, and it cannot be lifted early. The reason is one of four and is counted in the vendor scorecard.

materialsErrors.unknown_document: No such delivery, transfer or record
materialsErrors.unknown_uom: That unit is not one of this item's units
materialsErrors.drug_needs_medicine: A drug-class item must name the formulary medicine it stocks
materialsErrors.non_drug_has_medicine: Only a drug-class item may name a formulary medicine
materialsErrors.base_uom_required: The base unit must be the item's own, and there can be only one
materialsErrors.vendor_not_active: That vendor is not active — activate it before receiving from it
materialsErrors.vendor_blacklisted: That vendor is blacklisted and nothing may be received from it
materialsErrors.blacklist_active: The blacklist period has not ended yet
materialsErrors.approval_not_granted: That change has not been approved yet
materialsErrors.agreement_missing: No signed consignment agreement is valid on the challan date
materialsErrors.documents_incomplete: The vendor's statutory documents are incomplete
materialsErrors.near_expiry_unapproved: A near-expiry line needs the materials head's acceptance before posting
materialsErrors.batch_mismatch: That batch already exists with different details — a human must say which is right
materialsErrors.insufficient_stock: There is not enough available stock
materialsErrors.lot_exhausted: The consignment lot has nothing left to deploy
materialsErrors.qc_not_run: Run gate QC before posting this delivery
materialsErrors.negative_stock: That movement would take stock below zero
materialsErrors.permission_denied: Your login does not have the stock-count permission this needs
materialsErrors.unknown_count: That stock count does not exist
materialsErrors.count_already_open: This store is already being counted — finish or cancel that count first
materialsErrors.no_eligible_counter: Nobody can count this store: every counter either keeps its stock or scheduled the count. Give the count permission to someone else
materialsErrors.not_countable: The transit store, or a retired store, cannot be counted
materialsErrors.count_not_assigned: This count sheet belongs to the person the system assigned
materialsErrors.count_not_open: This count is no longer being counted
materialsErrors.count_incomplete: Every line needs its count — a blank is not a zero
materialsErrors.invalid_count_qty: A count is a whole number, zero or more
materialsErrors.invalid_count_time: The counting time must be after the count was scheduled and not in the future
materialsErrors.count_not_submitted: Only a submitted count can be closed
materialsErrors.nothing_to_adjust: There is no variance to book on that line
materialsErrors.recount_pending: That line was sent for a blind recount — book the recount's line instead
materialsErrors.already_requested: That line's variance is already asked for or booked
materialsErrors.invalid_adjustment_reason: That reason does not fit the direction: 'found' books stock on, the loss reasons write it off
materialsErrors.adjustment_unapproved: Nothing is booked until the medical superintendent approves the request
materialsErrors.transfer_self_receipt: You sent this transfer. Someone at the receiving store confirms it.
materialsErrors.not_store_keeper: Only the receiving store's own staff confirm what reached it.
materialsErrors.po_wrong_status: The purchase order is not in a state that allows this
materialsErrors.po_invalid: The order has a line or detail it cannot carry — check quantities, rates and packs
materialsErrors.po_over_receipt: More than the order allows (ordered + 2%) — put free goods on their own line
materialsErrors.po_mismatch: This delivery is not for that purchase order (vendor, store or item differs)
materialsErrors.po_approver_receiving: You approved this order — somebody else must receive it
materialsErrors.invalid_stock_level: Levels must hold 0 ≤ min ≤ reorder < max
materialsErrors.unknown_supplier_bill: That supplier bill does not exist.
materialsErrors.bill_wrong_status: The bill is not in a state that allows this.
materialsErrors.bill_invalid: The bill cannot be saved as entered — check the GRN, the numbers and the date.
materialsErrors.duplicate_bill: This vendor's bill number is already booked in this financial year.
materialsErrors.grn_already_billed: That GRN is already on another bill.
materialsErrors.bill_self_accept: You entered this bill; somebody else accepts its difference.
materialsErrors.unknown_payment_run: That payment run does not exist.
materialsErrors.run_wrong_status: The payment run is not in a state that allows this.
materialsErrors.run_invalid: The run cannot be saved — a bill is not payable, or the amount is more than it still owes.
materialsErrors.run_not_preparer: Only the person who prepared the run submits it.
materialsErrors.authoriser_recording: You authorised this run; somebody else records it paid.
materialsErrors.vendor_cooling_off: The vendor's bank details changed recently; the first payment waits for the cooling-off to end.
materialsErrors.cash_limit_exceeded: Cash to one vendor in one day cannot pass ₹10,000 (Income-tax Act s.40A(3)) — pay by bank.
materialsErrors.payment_reference_required: Type the UTR or the cheque number.
materialsErrors.unknown_supplier_return: That return to the supplier was not found.
materialsErrors.return_wrong_status: The return is not in a state that allows this — refresh and look at it again.
materialsErrors.return_invalid: A line on the return does not fit: check the batch, its supplier, the reason and the quantity.
materialsErrors.not_returnable: This stock cannot go back to a supplier (the hospital's own opening or trial stock, or not bought stock) — destroy it with a write-off instead.
materialsErrors.return_window_passed: This batch is past the vendor's return window after expiry — it is destroyed with a write-off, not returned.
materialsErrors.return_self_approve: You drafted this return — somebody else approves it.
materialsErrors.approver_dispatching: You approved this return — somebody else dispatches it.
materialsErrors.credit_invalid: The credit note does not fit: it may not be more than our debit note, a short credit needs its reason, and its date cannot be in the future.
materialsErrors.credit_spent: A payment run has already used this credit — cancel or edit that run first.

pharmacyPharmacists.title: Pharmacists
pharmacyPharmacists.intro: The Pharmacy Act, 1948 reserves dispensing to a registered pharmacist. The counter's verify and every Schedule H or H1 hand-over need a current state pharmacy council registration on file. The pharmacist in charge files each colleague's certificate here; nobody files or ends their own.

pharmacyReorder.title: Reorder list
pharmacyReorder.intro: What the counter will run out of, from its own use over the last {{days}} days. A line is flagged under {{min}} days of cover, and the suggestion tops it up to {{target}} days, in whole packs. Nothing here moves stock: the store issues it, or purchasing orders it.
pharmacyReorder.expiringTitle: Near expiry at the counter (next {{days}} days)
pharmacyReorder.expiringIntro: The counter sells the earliest-expiring batch first. At the pace above, whatever a batch cannot sell before its date will expire on the shelf, so it is not counted as cover. Send it back while there is time: to the main store for a busier counter, or to the supplier under the expiry-return terms.

retail_licence_missing.title: No retail drug licence (Form 20 / 21) is on file
retail_licence_missing.sub: The walk-in counter sells nothing until one is recorded
retail_licence_missing.head: Record the retail licence
retail_licence_missing.why: The walk-in counter refuses every sale unless a licence on file covers today (Drugs and Cosmetics Act §18(c)). This records the licence numbers and dates the licensing authority issued.
retail_licence_missing.who: Recorded by the pharmacist in charge or the owner

retail_licence_lapsed.title: The retail drug licence (Form 20 / 21) lapsed on {{until}}
retail_licence_lapsed.sub: The walk-in counter has stopped selling · licence {{form20}}
retail_licence_lapsed.head: The retail licence has lapsed
retail_licence_lapsed.why: The walk-in counter refuses every sale once the licence on file does not cover today (Drugs and Cosmetics Act §18(c)). The renewal is filed with the licensing authority; this records the new numbers and dates.
retail_licence_lapsed.who: Recorded by the pharmacist in charge or the owner

retail_licence_not_yet_valid.title: The retail drug licence on file starts only on {{from}}
retail_licence_not_yet_valid.sub: The walk-in counter does not sell before then · licence {{form20}}
retail_licence_not_yet_valid.head: The retail licence is not valid yet
retail_licence_not_yet_valid.why: The counter sells only inside the licence's dates. If the dates were typed wrongly, record the licence again with the right ones.
retail_licence_not_yet_valid.who: Recorded by the pharmacist in charge or the owner

retail_licence_lapsing.title: Retail drug licence (Form 20 / 21) lapses on {{until}}
retail_licence_lapsing.sub: Walk-in counter stops selling the day it lapses · licence {{form20}}
retail_licence_lapsing.head: Retail licence lapses in {{days}} days
retail_licence_lapsing.why: The walk-in counter refuses every sale once the licence on file does not cover today (Drugs and Cosmetics Act §18(c)). The renewal is filed with the licensing authority; this records the new numbers and dates.
retail_licence_lapsing.who: Recorded by the pharmacist in charge or the owner

cabinet_licence_missing.title: Not on file: {{licenceName}}
cabinet_licence_missing.sub: The drugs it covers are not dispensed until it is recorded
cabinet_licence_missing.head: A controlled-drug licence is missing
cabinet_licence_missing.why: Narcotic and Schedule X drugs are dispensed only under a current licence (NDPS Rules r.52-O; D&C Rules r.61(3)). Record it on the cabinet's licences sheet.

cabinet_licence_lapsed.title: Lapsed on {{until}}: {{licenceName}}
cabinet_licence_lapsed.sub: The drugs it covers are not dispensed until it is renewed
cabinet_licence_lapsed.head: A controlled-drug licence has lapsed
cabinet_licence_lapsed.why: Narcotic and Schedule X drugs are dispensed only under a current licence (NDPS Rules r.52-O; D&C Rules r.61(3)). Record the renewal on the cabinet's licences sheet.

cabinet_licence_not_yet_valid.title: Not valid yet: {{licenceName}}
cabinet_licence_not_yet_valid.sub: The drugs it covers are not dispensed before its start date
cabinet_licence_not_yet_valid.head: A controlled-drug licence is not valid yet
cabinet_licence_not_yet_valid.why: The cabinet dispenses only inside a licence's dates. If they were typed wrongly, record the licence again.

cabinet_licence_renewal.title: {{licenceName}} ends on {{until}} — apply for renewal
cabinet_licence_renewal.sub: Renewal is applied for 60 days ahead · {{days}} days left
cabinet_licence_renewal.head: Renew a controlled-drug licence
cabinet_licence_renewal.why: NDPS Rules r.52-O: renewal is applied for 60 days before the recognition ends; after it lapses the drugs it covers are not dispensed.

cabinet_storeMissing.title: The controlled-drug cabinet (PHARM-NDPS) does not exist
cabinet_storeMissing.sub: Deploy creates it; nothing controlled can be received until then
cabinet_storeMissing.head: No controlled-drug cabinet
cabinet_storeMissing.why: Narcotic and Schedule X stock lives only in its own store, with its own register.

cabinet_noPair.title: Nobody can witness at the cabinet besides its key-holder
cabinet_noPair.sub: Assign a second person the witness grant
cabinet_noPair.head: The cabinet needs a second key
cabinet_noPair.why: Every act at the cabinet is made under two keys: a custodian and a different witness.
cabinet_noPair.who: Roles are assigned by the administrator

cabinet_checkNotDone.title: Today's balance check of the cabinet is not done
cabinet_checkNotDone.sub: Count every controlled batch with a witness
cabinet_checkNotDone.head: The cabinet's daily balance check
cabinet_checkNotDone.why: The controlled-drug register is balanced every day against a physical count, witnessed.

cabinet_discrepancies.head: The cabinet did not balance
cabinet_discrepancies.why: A count that does not meet the register is booked only when the medical superintendent approves the variance.

cabinet_actsWaiting.title_one: {{count}} act at the cabinet waits for two keys
cabinet_actsWaiting.title_other: {{count}} acts at the cabinet wait for two keys
cabinet_actsWaiting.sub: GRNs, transfers, write-offs or a count's variance
cabinet_actsWaiting.head: Acts waiting at the cabinet
cabinet_actsWaiting.why: Nothing moves into or out of the cabinet without a custodian and a witness.

pharmacist_lapsed.title: {{name}}'s registration {{no}} has lapsed
pharmacist_lapsed.sub: They cannot verify, dispense or hand over until a current one is recorded
pharmacist_lapsed.head: A pharmacist's registration lapsed
pharmacist_lapsed.why: Pharmacy Act 1948 §42: only a registered pharmacist dispenses. The counter refuses their acts until a current registration is on file.
pharmacist_lapsed.who: Pharmacist in charge files it (never its holder)

pharmacist_expiring.title: {{name}}'s registration {{no}} ends on {{until}}
pharmacist_expiring.sub: Record the renewal before it lapses · {{days}} days left
pharmacist_expiring.head: A pharmacist's registration is ending
pharmacist_expiring.why: Pharmacy Act 1948 §42: only a registered pharmacist dispenses. After the date on file the counter refuses their acts.
pharmacist_expiring.who: Pharmacist in charge files it (never its holder)

pharmacist_trial.title: Pharmacist registration {{no}} is a trial number
pharmacist_trial.sub: Bills and the H1 register print TRIAL until the real council number is recorded
pharmacist_trial.head: Replace the trial registration
pharmacist_trial.why: Pharmacy Act 1948: only a registered pharmacist dispenses. A trial number keeps the counter working in rehearsal; it is not a registration.
pharmacist_trial.who: Pharmacist in charge files it (never its holder)

pay_overdue.sub: Oldest {{days}} days past due · MSME bills: {{msme}}
pay_overdue.head: Pay what is overdue
pay_overdue.why: MSMED Act §15: a micro or small supplier is paid within 45 days of acceptance, or interest runs at three times the bank rate and the amount is disallowed under §43B(h). Other suppliers are paid by their agreed terms.
pay_overdue.who: Prepared by materials head · authorised by owner · recorded by accounts

pay_msme_due.head: Pay MSME bills before the 45-day line
pay_msme_due.why: MSMED Act §15: a micro or small supplier is paid within 45 days of acceptance, or interest runs at three times the bank rate and the amount is disallowed under §43B(h). The copilot drafts the run; the materials head prepares it and the owner authorises it.
pay_msme_due.who: Prepared by materials head · authorised by owner · recorded by accounts

pay_due.head: Bills due this week
pay_due.why: Paying on the agreed terms keeps the supplier's credit open. The payment run carries them; the owner authorises it.
pay_due.who: Prepared by materials head · authorised by owner

run_authorise.title: Payment run {{runNo}} — {{total}} awaits authorisation
run_authorise.head: Authorise a payment run
run_authorise.why: A run is prepared by one person and authorised by the owner in the approvals inbox; somebody else then records each supplier paid.

bill_held.title: Bill {{billNo}} held for match — {{over}} over the GRN
bill_held.head: A bill does not match its delivery
bill_held.why: Three-way match: PO, GRN and bill. A difference beyond tolerance is accepted only by someone who holds that authority, with a reason; otherwise it goes back to the vendor.

po_approve.title: {{poNo}} · {{vendor}} — {{total}} awaits your approval
po_approve.sub: {{lines}} lines · raised for the {{tier}} to approve
po_approve.head: Approve a purchase order
po_approve.why: Every PO is approved before it is sent. The approver cannot be the person who later receives the goods (separation of duties: approver ≠ GRN receiver).

po_overdue.title: {{poNo}} · {{vendor}} was expected on {{expected}}
po_overdue.sub: {{days}} days late · not yet received in full
po_overdue.head: A purchase order is overdue
po_overdue.why: An approved order past its expected date is chased with the supplier, received, or cancelled with a reason.

po_draft.title: {{poNo}} · {{vendor}} — draft, {{total}}
po_draft.sub: {{lines}} lines · review and submit for approval
po_draft.head: A draft purchase order
po_draft.why: A draft is nobody's order until a person checks its lines and submits it for approval.

po_receive.head: Orders to receive
po_receive.why: Goods are received against the order at the GRN desk; the supplier's bill is matched only to what was received.

shortages.title_one: {{count}} drug is on the short book
shortages.title_other: {{count}} drugs are on the short book
shortages.head: The counter's short book
shortages.why: What the counter could not give today is ordered from its last supplier; the copilot drafts the orders and a person submits them.

recall_open.title: Recall {{recallNo}} — {{item}}, batch {{batch}}
recall_open.sub: {{onHand}} still on hand · return it and call back the patients it went to
recall_open.head: A drug recall is open
recall_open.why: A recalled batch is taken off the shelf, returned to its supplier, and the patients it was dispensed to are called back.

credit_awaited.title: Credit note awaited from {{vendor}} — debit note {{note}} · {{total}}
credit_awaited.sub: {{days}} days since dispatch · the payment run offsets it once recorded
credit_awaited.head: Record the supplier's credit note
credit_awaited.why: Our debit note is a claim; the supplier's credit note confirms it. Recording it lets the next payment run offset the amount.

writeoff_post.title: Write-off {{no}} approved — hand it to the disposal agency
writeoff_post.head: Post an approved write-off
writeoff_post.why: Expired stock is destroyed under the Bio-Medical Waste Rules: the agency's manifest number and the handover date are recorded and the stock leaves the books.

writeoff_approval.title: Write-off {{no}} waits for the medical superintendent
writeoff_approval.head: A write-off awaiting approval
writeoff_approval.why: Nothing is destroyed or written off until the medical superintendent approves it in the approvals inbox.

expiry.title: {{count}} batches expire within 90 days — {{value}} at cost
expiry.sub: {{returnable}} returnable to {{vendors}} suppliers inside their windows · {{destroy}} past the window: write off
expiry.head: Short-dated stock
expiry.why: A batch returned inside the supplier's window comes back as credit; after it, it is destroyed under the Bio-Medical Waste Rules and written off with the MS's approval.
expiry.who: Returns: materials head · write-off: MS approves

expiry_expired.title: {{expired}} batches have expired on the shelf — {{expiredValue}}
expiry_expired.sub: {{count}} more expire within 90 days · {{returnable}} returnable · {{destroy}} to write off
expiry_expired.head: Expired stock on the shelf
expiry_expired.why: Expired stock is never dispensed. Inside the supplier's window it goes back as credit; after it, it is destroyed under the Bio-Medical Waste Rules and written off with the MS's approval.
expiry_expired.who: Returns: materials head · write-off: MS approves

grn_qc.title: {{grnNo}} from {{vendor}} waits for the pharmacist's QC
grn_qc.sub: Challan {{challan}} · {{lines}} lines · nothing is on the shelf until posted
grn_qc.head: A delivery waiting for QC
grn_qc.why: The storekeeper captured the delivery; the pharmacist runs QC and posts it — the two-person gate every delivery passes.

opening_qc.title_one: Opening stock: {{count}} GRN captured, waiting for the pharmacist's QC
opening_qc.title_other: Opening stock: {{count}} GRNs captured, waiting for the pharmacist's QC
opening_qc.sub: {{challan}} · {{lines}} lines · nothing is on the shelf until posted
opening_qc.head: Opening stock waiting for QC
opening_qc.why: The sheet was captured by the storekeeper; the pharmacist runs QC and posts each GRN, the same two-person gate as a delivery.

adr_pvpi_overdue.title: {{no}} — serious reaction not sent to PvPI
adr_pvpi_overdue.head: Send the ADR report to PvPI
adr_pvpi_overdue.why: PvPI asks for a serious adverse drug reaction within 15 days of the hospital knowing of it. This one is past that.
adr_pvpi_overdue.who: Pharmacist in charge or the medical superintendent

adr_pvpi_serious.title: {{no}} — serious reaction to send to PvPI
adr_pvpi_serious.head: Send the ADR report to PvPI
adr_pvpi_serious.why: PvPI asks for a serious adverse drug reaction within 15 days. Print the form, send it through the AMC, the ADR PvPI app or e-mail, and record the send.
adr_pvpi_serious.who: Pharmacist in charge or the medical superintendent

adr_pvpi.title: {{no}} — reaction not yet sent to PvPI
adr_pvpi.head: Send the ADR report to PvPI
adr_pvpi.why: Every suspected adverse drug reaction is reported to PvPI (NABH MOM). A non-serious one has no 15-day clock but still goes.
adr_pvpi.who: Pharmacist in charge or the medical superintendent

incident_review_overdue.title: {{no}} — harmful medication error not reviewed in 24 h
incident_review_overdue.head: Review the medication incident
incident_review_overdue.why: An error at NCC MERP E or above reached the patient and may have harmed them. It is reviewed — root cause and action taken — within 24 hours.
incident_review_overdue.who: Pharmacist in charge or the medical superintendent

incident_review.title: {{no}} — medication incident to review
incident_review.head: Review the medication incident
incident_review.why: Every medication error and near miss is reviewed for its root cause and the action taken (NABH MOM). A near miss is the cheapest lesson the pharmacy gets.
incident_review.who: Pharmacist in charge or the medical superintendent

cold_excursion_open.title: {{no}} — fridge {{label}} went out of range; {{batches}} cold batches on hold
cold_excursion_open.sub: {{store}} · the held stock does not leave until it is decided
cold_excursion_open.head: Decide the held cold stock
cold_excursion_open.why: A reading outside the fridge's range (2–8 °C unless set otherwise) holds every cold batch that was in that store. Release each against the product's stability data, or write it off (D&C Rules: store as the label directs).
cold_excursion_open.who: Pharmacist in charge or the materials head

cold_reading_missed.title: {{label}} — the {{slot}} reading was missed
cold_reading_missed.sub: {{store}} · read the fridge now and note why it was late
cold_reading_missed.head: Read the fridge
cold_reading_missed.why: Fridges are read at 09:00 and 17:00 (NABH MOM: the cold chain is monitored and documented). A gap in the log is a gap in the proof that the stock was kept cold.

steward_not_appointed.title: No antimicrobial steward is appointed
steward_not_appointed.sub: Restricted antimicrobials are in the formulary · none can leave the counter until one is appointed
steward_not_appointed.head: Appoint an antimicrobial steward
steward_not_appointed.why: Reserve and restricted antimicrobials need the steward's prior approval (ICMR AMSP 2018). Appoint the infectious-disease physician, else the clinical microbiologist, else the AMSP lead the medical superintendent names.
steward_not_appointed.who: The administrator, on the medical superintendent's word

steward_approval_waiting.title: {{no}} — a restricted antimicrobial has waited {{hours}} h for the steward
steward_approval_waiting.sub: The patient's medicine is held until the antimicrobial steward decides
steward_approval_waiting.head: Chase the steward's decision
steward_approval_waiting.why: A restricted antimicrobial leaves only with the steward's approval; an urgent request is decided within four hours.

tray_deficient.title: {{tray}} — {{no}} found the tray deficient; not restocked
tray_deficient.sub: {{location}} · an emergency tray short or expiring is not ready for the next patient
tray_deficient.head: Restock the emergency tray
tray_deficient.why: Emergency medications are replenished promptly after use or when found short (NABH MOM). Restock issues exactly the deficit from the pharmacy; the tray's keeper receives it.

tray_daily_missed.title: {{tray}} — today's seal check is not done
tray_daily_missed.head: Check the tray's seal
tray_daily_missed.why: Every emergency tray's seal is checked daily (NABH MOM: emergency medications are checked). A broken seal means a full check.

tray_monthly_missed.title: {{tray}} — this month's full check is not done
tray_monthly_missed.head: Do the monthly full check
tray_monthly_missed.why: Once a month the tray is opened and every item counted against par and its expiry read (NABH MOM).
tray_monthly_missed.who: The tray's keeper or the pharmacist

tray_expiring.title: {{tray}} — {{item}} batch {{batch}} expires {{expiry}}
tray_expiring.sub: {{qty}} in the tray · replace it before it expires
tray_expiring.head: Replace expiring tray stock
tray_expiring.why: A tray drug inside 30 days of expiry is replaced so the tray is never found with expired stock at a code.

rosterMonth.title: Roster — the unit's month
rosterMonth.intro: Built from the unit's pattern, who is posted here, and approved leave. Change any box; it re-checks as you go. Nobody sees it until you publish.
rosterMonth.introPublished: The hospital works to this month now. A duty changes hands only by a cover or a swap — tap it to see who can take it, checked against every rule.
rosterMonth.introPublishedRead: The hospital works to this month now. To change one of your own duties, use My duties — "I can't do this".

rosterMonth.noUnits: No department runs units yet, so there is no unit roster to open.
rosterMonth.cannotDraft: The unit's senior resident or its head drafts this month. You can read it once they have.
rosterMonth.gridFoot: A night is 20:00 to 08:00 and is always followed by 12 hours' rest, shown after it. A duty inside that rest is a must-fix. Tap a duty to change who does it.
rosterMonth.noFindings: Nothing in this month breaks a rule.

rosterMonth.publishBlocked_other: {{count}} must-fix items stand. Fix each on the grid, or leave that duty vacant — a must-fix cannot be signed away here.
rosterMonth.publishNotYours: Only the unit's head or the medical superintendent can publish a roster. Everything above is ready for them.
rosterMonth.publishedNote: "Who is on now" already reads from it. Changes from here are swaps and amendments, each checked the same way.

rosterEvidence.title: Duty evidence
rosterEvidence.intro: What the roster gave each person, day by day, and what the hospital's records show them doing. The sheet states facts and draws no conclusion from them.
rosterEvidence.noDepartments: There is nobody whose roster you answer for. The sheet is run by a head of department for their own staff, or by the medical superintendent.
rosterEvidence.maxPeople: A sheet covers at most {{max}} people.
rosterEvidence.badRange: Choose a first and a last day, at most 31 days apart, the last not before the first.
rosterEvidence.previewTitle: The sheet, as it will print
rosterEvidence.previewEmpty: Choose people and days, then Show the sheet. It appears here exactly as the printer will print it.
rosterEvidence.queued: Sent to the office printer. Reference {{ref}}.
rosterEvidence.already: This sheet is already on its way to the office printer (reference {{ref}}).
rosterEvidence.notServed: Queued, reference {{ref}} — but no print relay has been heard from lately, so nothing may come off the office printer yet. Ask IT to check the relay and that it serves the office A4 printer; the sheet prints as soon as it does.
rosterEvidence.rule1: For each day: the duty the published roster gave, and what the records hold — theatre wheel-in and wheel-out, approved leave or deputation, a declared holiday.
rosterEvidence.rule2: It says what the records hold and nothing about what they mean. The college reads it beside AEBAS.
rosterEvidence.rule3: It never shows a phone number, a patient, or why anybody was on leave.
rosterEvidence.sourcesLater: Labour room, casualty and ward rounds join this list when those records name a person.
rosterEvidence.ask: e.g. which days of September show theatre times?

rosterAebas.title: AEBAS to-do
rosterAebas.intro: Leave, deputation and holidays approved here, to enter in AEBAS by hand before they begin — AEBAS takes nothing after the day. HMIS does not connect to AEBAS.
rosterAebas.missedSub: AEBAS will not take these now. Mark one only if it was entered after all.
rosterAebas.upcomingSub: Each is due the day before it begins.
rosterAebas.empty: Nothing to enter. Every approved leave and holiday the roster holds is already marked entered in AEBAS.
rosterAebas.enteredNone: Nothing marked in the last seven days.
rosterAebas.how1: Every approved leave, deputation and tour, and every declared holiday, appears here the moment it is approved or declared.
rosterAebas.how2: Enter it in AEBAS, then tap Entered in AEBAS. It leaves the list.
rosterAebas.how3: Anything due today and not marked shows red on the hospital's readiness check.
